title: Fish Em LLC

services.name: Ice Fishing
services.desc: Looking to fill your freezer with the best WILD SALMON in the world? This is the trip for you, no farmed salmon here! These are organic hormone free salmon, fresh in from the ocean! 1 day guided fishing trip to the hottest location on the Kenai River. Peak dates are July 10th - August 15th. The Kenai Style package includes 3 days on the Kenai and/or Kasilof river. This could look like 1 day guided fishing trip on the middle Kenai River, and 1 day guided boating fishing trip on the lower Kenai River and another day one a section of the Kenai or Kasilof depending fishing conditions and target fish. All locations will have the possibility of seeing various wildlife. The Kenai River is 85 miles

gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: A: The weather changes rapidly so make sure you bring layers, extra clothes, and thick socks.

quotes.text: We had a spectacular time fishing the Kenai with Travis of Fish Em LLC. He was great and extremely patient. From getting us set up with our gear to putting us at ease while on the river he made it easy and relaxing. He was very patient while instructing us on the proper technique. He took us to a great spot to fish. We were very successful and left with 9 sockeye. We even managed to catch and release a couple of rainbows. It was a wonderful trip and I highly recommend Fish Em LLC to anyone from longtime Alaskans to visitors looking for a little outdoor fun in our beautiful state. -Krshafer-

My husband is a avid fisherman and though I am a long time Alaskan I am a newbie at fishing. We have gone together on several of Fish Em’s full day fishing charters and I appreciate the fact that Travis is able to provide a great fishing experience for both of us. My husband can fish like crazy while I can practice with a skilled fishing technician close by to assist with tips and encouragement. Being successful catching the big ones is great fun and definitely makes us want to continue fishing with Fish Em. Thanks, Travis and Lori!” -FRZNinAK-

Travis and Lori are awesome to work with!!! We showed up with my family without any fishing trips booked and they were able to accommodate us into a half day trip. We limited out on reds even though the first run was basically over… and we caught some rainbows on our drift.
